criteria.justification: At Step 2 the student correctly identifies 2x as the common factor of 2x^2 - 8x (Step 3 is verified equivalent to Step 1), but divides it out rather than factorising it out, so only partial credit for the factorisation method.
Step 2 divides both sides by 2x rather than retaining both factors; Step 4 is verified as losing the root x = 0.

Step 4 gives only x = 4 (verified to have lost x = 0), and Step 5 did not parse but on the written evidence the student states this is the only answer — so one root only (answer line not machine-verified).
